note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-4 Patria AMV 8x8 datasheet, with the tier-5 English Wikipedia compilation retained for the fields the datasheet does not publish. The registry marks the datasheet primary_held true; the held bytes are the Patria brochure from the warwheels.net mirror. The datasheet publishes the length for the standard and longer hull, the height over the hull, the width, the track width, the torque output and the automatic transmission with 7 + 1 gears; those fields are grade claimed at the manufacturer tier. It names no engine model and publishes the 17,000 to 27,000 kg weight as a range and the maximum speed as greater than 100 km/h, so the weight, engine-model, power, speed and range fields remain on the tier-5 compilation at grade claimed.

operating_weight_kg.state: weight published as a range of 16,000 to 32,000 kg; the lower bound of the range recorded, not an average

length_mm.locator: Technical specifications panel, Dimensions, Length row
length_mm.state: length published as 7.9 m for the standard hull; the same row publishes 8.3 m for the longer hull

width_mm.locator: Technical specifications panel, Dimensions, Width row

height_mm.locator: Technical specifications panel, Dimensions, Height over hull row
height_mm.state: height over the hull published as 2.4 m; the same row publishes 2.7 m with the high roof

track_mm.locator: Technical specifications panel, Dimensions, Track width row

engine_model.state: engine published as a Scania DI 12, DC 12 or DC 13 diesel

net_power_kw.state: engine power published as 450 kW, or 405 kW, or 360 kW; the highest option recorded, not an average, with no net basis stated

torque_nm.locator: Technical specifications panel, Engine, Torque output row
torque_nm.state: torque output published as 2,090 N m

transmission_type.locator: Technical specifications panel, Engine, Automatic row

gears.locator: Technical specifications panel, Engine, Automatic row
gears.state: seven forward and one reverse gear published as 7 + 1

max_speed_kmh.locator: Infobox, speed row, on land entry
max_speed_kmh.state: land speed published as over 100 km/h; the water speed is published as up to 10 km/h

range_km.state: range published as a range of 600 to 1,000 km; the lower bound of the range recorded, not an average
